sources.title: River861/RetrievalAttention
sources.relevance: The local target repository already exposes environment-gated late block-cache allocation, pinned side-stream late metadata migration, uninitialized late block-cache init, async cluster ID copy, buffer multiplier, and per-layer capacity scaling controls used by opt015.

sources.title: PyTorch CUDA semantics and memory APIs
sources.relevance: CUDA stream and synchronization semantics remain relevant to the pinned side-stream metadata migration path; no material documentation update required a source mechanism pivot for opt015.

sources.title: PyTorch torch.empty
sources.relevance: torch.empty remains an uninitialized allocation primitive, so the opt013/opt015 uninitialized late block-cache policy is valid only under the existing write-before-read safety invariant.

sources.title: LMCache
sources.relevance: Tiered KV-cache reuse/offload remains adjacent evidence for streaming residency; opt015 continues using RetroInfer's existing per-layer block-cache capacity controls rather than importing a new infrastructure stack.

material_updates.action: Keep the current opt013 stack and bound the search to three late/tail lower-capacity schedules.
material_updates.finding: The immediately preceding opt014 refresh found adjacent per-layer and streaming KV-cache work, but no project-native or toolchain evidence that justifies a new mechanism or harness pivot. Opt014 measurements also showed early layer-1 reductions were decode-negative.
material_updates.impact: Proceed with RETROINFER_LAYER_CACHE_CAPACITY_SCALE schedules that keep layers 1/2/3 at opt013 capacity and apply new cuts only to layers 25/28/29.

material_updates.finding: PyTorch's uninitialized-memory semantics still require that tensors are fully written before read, and side-stream H2D copies still require explicit synchronization before dependent decode work.
material_updates.impact: Only raw runs with clean exit and RETROINFER_OUTPUT_JSON.all_outputs_contain_groundtruth=true can be compared; no speed or memory claim is made for a correctness-failed schedule.

decision_impact: Opt015 should measure the requested late/tail lower-capacity schedules on real A100 hardware and retain a schedule only if it reduces block-cache/peak memory without worse decode or e2e generated throughput versus opt013; otherwise record the late-layer capacity recovery as refuted on the current stack.
